answer: Written in a historical context, lessons from prior systems register, it stays short. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on token-curated registries for quality signals. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the nebula of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. A walnut of per-task receipts records who did what, and the vault of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
